about: This doxology closes the Canon. The priest makes three signs of the cross with the Host over the chalice, then two between himself and the chalice. At omnis honor et glória he slightly raises the chalice with the Host. He says the closing Per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum audibly, and the people answer Amen.

seg.nr: The priest uncovers the chalice, genuflects, takes the Host in his right hand and the chalice in his left, and makes three signs of the cross with the Host from rim to rim of the chalice.

seg.tr: Through Him, and with Him, and in Him,

ex.w002: Ipsum refers to Christ, named in the preceding prayer.

seg.nr: With the Host the priest makes two signs of the cross between himself and the chalice.

seg.tr: belong to You, God the almighty Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit,

seg.nr: The priest raises the chalice a little, with the Host.
The priest sets down the Host, covers the chalice with the pall, genuflects, rises, and says in an audible voice or sings:
